story: LOC-11 relay road, 120 km in five playable segments (Chapter 8); 80 m vista grid, cut 10 m patches for the playable segments with make_terrain.window_m
source_title: A New View of the Lunar South Pole from LOLA: LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (80S-90S, 80 m/px)
format: r16: little-endian uint16, row-major, top row first (north = toward 0 deg E is up); height_m = z_min_m + value * (z_max_m - z_min_m) / 65535
height_datum: metres above the 1,737.4 km reference sphere (LOLA)
projection: south polar stereographic, MOON_ME (DE421); x toward 90E, y toward 0E, pole at (0,0)
origin_note: map coordinates of the centre of pixel (column 0, row 0)

godot.frame: X = map x - site x; Z = -(map y - site y); Y = height - site height (site at the origin, metres)
